* Sticky header appearing/disappearing is implemented using vue-use useScroll (see Ikea example)

summary: A responsive shop header providing logo, search, navigation menu, and shopping tools with intelligent sticky scroll behavior.
features: Desktop two-line layout with logo, search bar, and icon actions
Horizontal navigation bar with category structure or manual menu items
Smart sticky behavior: hide on scroll down, reveal on scroll up
Mobile variants with visible search field or icon button
longDescription:
## Purpose

The ShopHeader component serves as the primary navigation anchor for international online stores, providing consistent access to search, categories, and shopping tools across all devices. It enables seamless product browsing while maintaining quick access to account, wishlist, and cart functionality.

## Use Cases

- **Category Browsing**: Display category structure automatically from the store tree or create manual menu items with custom ordering. Apply sale styling to highlight promotional categories.
- **Mega Menu Access**: Show large flyout menus on hover or click (configurable) for deep category exploration.
- **Shopping Tools**: Access account login, wishlist (with item count badge), and cart (with item count and optional flyout summary) via persistent icon buttons.
- **Responsive Behavior**: On mobile, choose between visible search field or compact icon button. Account moves to off-canvas menu.

## Design Rationale

The sticky scroll behavior (implemented via vue-use useScroll) maximizes content visibility while keeping navigation accessible. The overflow navigation using swiper handles stores with many top-level categories gracefully. Separate light/dark mode logo inputs ensure brand consistency across themes.

Supports category browsing with automatic store tree display or manual menu items with custom ordering. Sale styling highlights promotional categories. Mega menu flyouts appear on hover or click for deep category exploration. Shopping tools include account login, wishlist with item count badge, and cart with optional flyout summary.
